title: UAV-Based Object Detection
description: Developed an object detection model using YOLOv8n to identify objects in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery. The project involved working with a large image dataset, training the model, and evaluating its detection performance.
keyFeatures: Dataset: 14,471 UAV images
Model: YOLOv8n
Training: 50 epochs
Reported result: 86.15% mAP@50
Demonstrates: dataset preparation, object detection, model training, and evaluation using computer vision techniques.

title: Automated Crack Segmentation
description: Developed a U-Net-based image segmentation model to identify crack regions in images. The work focused on preparing image data, training a segmentation architecture, and assessing the quality of predicted segmentation masks.
keyFeatures: Dataset: Approximately 800 images
Architecture: U-Net
Dice score: 0.8293
F1 score: 84%
Demonstrates: image preprocessing, semantic segmentation, deep learning model development, and segmentation evaluation.

title: Breast Cancer Classification
description: Built a breast cancer classification model using Logistic Regression to predict diagnostic outcomes from structured data. The project involved data preparation, model development, and evaluation using classification metrics.
keyFeatures: Algorithm: Logistic Regression
Accuracy: 98.2%
F1 score: 98.6%
ROC-AUC: 0.995
Demonstrates: classification, data preprocessing, model evaluation, and the application of machine learning to a healthcare-related problem.
These are results on the project dataset, not evidence of clinical validation or readiness for medical use.

title: MNIST Handwritten Digit Recognition
description: Implemented a feedforward neural network using TensorFlow/Keras to classify handwritten digits from the MNIST dataset. The project provided practical experience with neural network construction, model training, and image classification.
keyFeatures: Dataset: MNIST
Framework: TensorFlow / Keras
Architecture: Feedforward neural network
Demonstrates: neural network implementation, image classification, and deep learning fundamentals.
